data.summary: TechMarkt Online GmbH sent a first payment reminder (1. Mahnung) for invoice TM-2026-0048213, which was due on 3 September 2026. With a €5.00 reminder fee added, the total of €94.99 must now be paid by 30 September 2026.
data.explanation: This is a first dunning notice for an unpaid invoice, now including a €5 reminder fee. Pay the total amount shown to the given account by the stated deadline. If you already paid, you can disregard this letter. If you miss the deadline, the company says it will hand the claim over to a debt collection agency (Inkassodienstleister), which would add further costs. Check first whether the original invoice was already settled before paying again.
